text: 兆易创新公告称，公司于2026年10月15日通过上海证券交易所回购A股股份145,200股，占公司现有已发行股份（不含库存股）的0.02%，每股回购价区间为271.43元-281.29元，回购总金额为4003.43万元，所回购股份拟全部注销。截至2026年10月15日，公司已发行股份总数为670,718,327股，库存股数量为0。
text_en: GigaDevice announced that on October 15, 2026, the company repurchased 145,200 A-shares through the Shanghai Stock Exchange, accounting for 0.02% of the company's existing issued shares (excluding treasury shares), at a repurchase price range of RMB 271.43 to RMB 281.29 per share, with a total repurchase amount of RMB 40.0343 million. The repurchased shares are intended to be fully cancelled. As of October 15, 2026, the company's total issued shares were 670,718,327, and the number of treasury shares was 0.
